description:
Advances: specled.package

Review-bar-override: a gate proposal, not a defect — the class recurs across reviews and should stop being reportable.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q (Recurring class 2).

docs_identifier_lint_test is one-directional today: it rejects doc references to finding codes that do not exist in lib, but it does not verify that docs ENUMERATE every code that does. So a table claiming to list "the full set of branch-guard codes" silently goes stale the moment a code is added, and the claim becomes false with nothing failing.

This has now bitten repeatedly: docs/adoption.md full-set claim (fixed on this branch), the finding_code_budget "tenth code" total with no counting rule (fixed on this branch), and the spec-prose overclaim class generally, which is a standing review checklist item.

Making the lint bidirectional mechanizes the enumeration half permanently. The phrase-level overclaims (comparatives with no basis, "impossible" where the truth is "deferred") stay a review concern — those are not mechanizable.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.package

Specifically specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity (.spec/specs/package.spec.md:112-115),
which is priority: must, stability: STABLE. Amending a STABLE must is the higher bar here — the
amendment is strictly STRENGTHENING (it adds an obligation), so append_only will not flag it and
no weakening ADR is needed, but route the exact must wording past a human in your completion
record. That requirement is already ~900 words of load-bearing prose, and growing it is
precisely the class specled_-vzd.3 exists to catch.

Allowed touches:
- test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md
- docs/adoption.md  (full-set-claim markers)
- docs/concepts.md  (ONLY if it carries a real full-set claim — see below, it does not)
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.doc_identifier_lint_spec_corpus.md  (amendment, only if the
  lint's corpus scope changes)

Out of Scope (files):
- all of lib/**
- skills/**, README.md
- any other .spec/decisions/**

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT implement "every known code must appear somewhere in docs." Measured at the epic base:
  docs + skills + README currently name 3 of 11 append_only/*, 2 of 2 overlap/*, 0 of 7
  evidence/*, and 0 of 8 cross_field/*. A whole-corpus reverse lint fails on 21 codes on day
  one. The lint MUST be scoped to explicitly-marked full-set-claim regions.
- Do not attempt phrase-level overclaims (comparatives with no basis, "impossible" where the
  truth is "deferred"). The ticket rules them out as non-mechanizable.
- Do NOT replace the hand-maintained @known_codes with reflection.
  specled.decision.doc_identifier_lint_spec_corpus forbids it, and
  docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:59-62 restates why.

CONCRETE DESIGN TO LAND: region markers, e.g.
  <!-- spec-lint:full-set=branch_guard_gated --> ... <!-- spec-lint:full-set-end -->
plus a per-marker expected-set map in the test. The two live claim sites are
docs/adoption.md:43 ("The full set of branch-guard codes mix spec.check gates on:", table at
:47-56, 8 codes) and docs/adoption.md:58-68 (triangulation-only table, 3 codes). 8 + 3 = 11 =
@branch_guard_codes (docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:127-139), so the family partitions cleanly
across two marked regions and the lint asserts the union equals the family.
docs/concepts.md:189 ("The full set is in the ...") is a POINTER, not a claim — it must NOT be
marked. Mirror the existing marker discipline; the family-count speed-bump test at
docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:322-335 is the precedent.

Verification:
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix test test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs
  mix test --only spec:specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity
  mix format --check-formatted
  make xref
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
NO stub flip: package.spec.md:126-132 already covers doc_identifier_integrity at execute: true.
New tests carry @tag spec: "specled.package.doc_identifier_integrity", or a new sibling id added
to that same covers: list.

Expected diff: 3-4 files, ~160 lines.
title: Make docs_identifier_lint bidirectional so full-set claims cannot go stale
